Lisa drew a big shrub with flat plates of white flowers, later drooping clusters of black berries in the dirt for the others. It'll wash away. The knowledge won't.
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
You were listening. Now you know European Elder too.
